description.text: Students who choose Chinese-teaching courses should study language program for 1-2 years to reach the level equivalent to HSK3, then they can start the clinical courses. Training Objective The course is designed to train nursing professionals with basic knowledge in humanity and social science, medicine and preventative care as well as the basic theories and skills of nursing, who can be engaged in clinical nursing, preventative care and nursing supervision in the nursing field. Training Requirements Studengts are required to study and grasp the basic theories and laws and regulations relevant to humanity and social science, preclinical medicine, and preventative health; to understand the basic theory, knowledge and skill of nursing, nursing principle and operating technology of acute and chronic patients, and special nursing and care skills; to apply nursing procedures to conduct overall nursing; and to have such basic abilities as in community health services, nursing management and nursing education with some nursing research capacity. Curriculum human anatomy, physiology, pathogenic organism, pathophysiology, pathology, pharmacology, nursing ethics, nursing psychology, health assessment, medical nursing, surgical nursing, nursing for gynecology, obstetrics, and pediatrics, psychiatric nursing, nursing for emergency treatment, community nursing, nursing management and so on. Employment orientation It is suitable for graduates to be engaged in clinicai nursing, nursing management as well as teaching and research work in hospitals at all levels, medical collages and universities as well as medical research institutions.

duration.text: The Nursing at Jinzhou Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 6.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1. Applicant is under the age of 25 2, Be in good health 3. high-school graduate with good marks 4. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
